dates.event: Online Registration & Fee Payment Last Date

howToApply: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) under the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.
After registering on NATS, apply for the UCO Bank Apprenticeship Program on the NATS portal.
Candidates will receive an email from BFSI SSC (info@bfsissc.com) inviting them to fill in detailed application information and make payment for the Online Examination at https://beep.bfsissc.com.
Pay the requisite non-refundable Application/Examination fee through ONLINE mode only from 14-10-2026 to 29-10-2026.
Appear for the Online Entrance Examination conducted by BFSI SSC on 07-11-2026 at 11 AM.
Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE State/UT only.
Keep the NATS Enrolment ID safe for all future correspondence.
No hard copy of application or documents is to be sent to the Bank’s office.

title: HPPSC Recruitment 2026 – Scientific Officer, Group-B (Job Trainee) Posts

fees.category: All Candidates (irrespective of category or gender)

howToApply: Visit the official website of HPPSC at http://www.hppsc.hp.gov.in/hppsc.
Click on the link ‘Apply Online’ on the Home Page.
Click on ‘One Time Registration (OTR) for Examinations’ and register/create your profile by clicking ‘New Registration’ if not already registered.

Fill in all required details carefully in the Online Recruitment Application (ORA).

Give an undertaking/declaration that uploaded documents are legible and true.
Pay the examination fee of Rs. 600/- through online mode (Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI or any other online digital mode) on or before 03/11/2026 by 11:59 PM.
Submit the application. No corrections/modifications will be allowed after submission.
Download and save the application for future reference.

title: AIIMS Bilaspur Recruitment 2026 – Senior Resident (Walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: AIIMS Bilaspur has announced notification for Senior Resident (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: DNB, MS/MD, MBBS, M.Sc, M.Phil/Ph.D. Last date to apply: 27-10-26.
howToApply: Candidates are not required to fill any online form.
Interested candidates are advised to report in person at the Recruitment Cell, 3rd Floor, Administrative Block, AIIMS Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, on or before 09:00 AM on 27th October 2026.

The duly filled and signed original application form must be produced at the time of interview along with one (1) set of self-attested photocopies of Degrees, Certificates, Mark sheets, Age proof, Caste certificates, PwBD certificate (if applicable) etc.
Original documents must be produced for verification at the time of the interview.
Annexure-II: Proforma/Checklist for the post of Senior Resident is to be filled and submitted during documents verification which shall take place before the interview.
Applicants working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institution must submit a ‘NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE’ (NOC) from the employers at the time of interview.
Application fee to be paid through NEFT to: State Bank of India, Bilaspur; Account Name: Recruitment Fund, AIIMS Bilaspur; Account No: 42734198120; IFSC: SBIN0063972.
Upload proof of fee payment and produce the same at the time of interview.
Incomplete forms or those without required documents will not be considered.

Read the R&P Rules, 2015 carefully before applying.
Ensure eligibility in respect of essential qualification(s), category, age, and experience.

Scan and keep ready: coloured recent photograph (20-50 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), signature (10-20 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG), Matric Certificate (100-500 KB), ID Proof (100-500 KB), and other certificates/documents (100 KB to 2 MB, PDF).

Upload all required documents and certificates.
Pay the examination fee ONLY through online mode.
Submit the application before 27.10.2026 at 11:59 PM.
Take a printout/screenshot of the submitted application for record.
Candidates already in government service must submit application through proper channel with NOC within 15 days from the last date.
